verdict.rationale: USCIS runs a public developer platform (Torch), so publishing llms.txt or agent-oriented docs is a fair question. The probe of https://www.uscis.gov/llms.txt returned HTTP 403, and no agent-oriented documentation index appears anywhere in the evidence. The Torch developer docs are conventional human-oriented API onboarding material, which is an adjacent feature and earns no credit for this story.
